tagline: The valley's back way, where a cavalry once ran for it.
intro: These are county roads off US 11, which follows the old Valley Pike. Back Road runs from SR 55 near Lebanon Church past Columbia Furnace to Forestville, and Middle Road carries on from Forestville to US 11 at Bowmans Crossing. Farther north a chain of county roads leaves US 11 near Maurertown, passes Saumsville and crosses Fetzer Gap to Star Tannery on Cedar Creek. Redbud Road, near Winchester, is a separate piece.

On October 9, 1864, Union cavalry turned on their pursuers, and Custer flanked Rosser's Confederates along the base of Spiker's Hill off Back Road, a rout so quick it was mocked as the Woodstock Races.

moments.title: Tom's Brook battlefield
moments.text: After the rout Jubal Early remarked sourly of Rosser's Laurel Brigade that the laurel is a running vine.

moments.title: Star Tannery
moments.text: The road over Fetzer Gap ends at this hamlet on Cedar Creek, just inside Frederick County on the Shenandoah County line.
